svg.text: Research Rover: Complete System Architecture Overview
Unified 7-Layer Flowchart Connecting User Interface, API Gateway, Scholarly APIs, Deduplication, NetworkX, FAISS & Visualizers
Research Rover Architecture v2.0 • Verified Implementation

g.text: LAYER 1: USER INTERACTION
Researcher Web Portal Access • Query Input • Parameter Configuration • Workspace Branching
Entry: Desktop/Tablet browser access at / • Live API & Model health verification pill
Workspaces: [A] Search (/search: PubMed/OpenAlex, year bounds, MedCPT sort) • [B] Analytics (/analytics: Keywords & Country tabs)
Conversational AI & Files: [C] RAG Chat (/chat: natural language Q&A, source cards) • [D] Custom CSV upload & architecture guide
↓ User Events
LAYER 2: FRONTEND / API CLIENT
React 19 SPA Architecture • Context Providers Stack • Axios Singleton Client • Error Normalization
Context State Hierarchy: ThemeProvider → SystemStatusProvider → SidebarProvider → SearchProvider → EmbeddingProvider → ChatProvider → AnalyticsProvider
Event Handlers & Polling: handleSearch(), pollProgress() (1000ms recurring timer), handleCancelSearch(), handleFileUpload() (FormData)
Axios Client Core (services/api.ts): Base URL: /api/v1 • Timeout: 120s • Typed modules: searchApi, filesApi, chatApi, embeddingsApi, analysisApi, systemApi
↓ HTTP Requests
LAYER 3: BACKEND CONTROLLERS
FastAPI Application Gateway • Pydantic Schema Validation • SSRF Security Check • Async Scheduling
ASGI Core (backend/main.py): Uvicorn (0.0.0.0:8000) • Lifespan background model loader • CORS middleware (allow all)
Mounted Routers: /api/v1/search (asyncio.Task) • /api/v1/files (SSRF safe download) • /api/v1/chat (RAG) • /api/v1/embeddings (BackgroundTasks) • /api/v1/analysis
Validation & Error Mapping: Pydantic schemas (schemas.py) → HTTP 422 • FileNotFoundError → HTTP 404 • CSVLoadError/SSRF → HTTP 400 • Crash → HTTP 500
↓ Service Invocations
LAYER 4: DATA COLLECTION
External Scholarly APIs • Parallel Dispatch • XML & Inverted Index Parsers • Non-Blocking Resilience
Search Orchestrators: SearchService & UnifiedSearchService launch parallel async queries across PubMed & OpenAlex
NCBI PubMed (E-Utilities): esearch (PMIDs, rate limit 0.10s) → espell (spell correction) → efetch (XML batches of 50) → esummary (exact dates)
OpenAlex API & CORE Stub: reconstruct_abstract() inverts abstract dictionary • extracts authors, affiliations, OA links • CORE planned stub
↓ Raw Paper Records
LAYER 5: CLEANING & STORAGE
Identifier Normalization • 4-Priority Deduplication • Country Extractor • Centralized CSV Storage
Normalization: normalize_doi (strip prefixes), normalize_pmid, normalize_openalex_id, compute_title_key (title60_year_author20)
4-Priority Deduplication (deduplicate_results): Match P1: DOI → P2: PMID → P3: OpenAlex ID → P4: title_key • Merge sources & longer text
Geographic Recognition & CSV Store: country_extractor.py (700+ aliases, ISO-3 code resolution) • data/*.csv storage via csv_loader.py (UTF-8-SIG)
↓ Structured Datasets
LAYER 6: ANALYSIS & COMPUTATION
8 Parallel Computational Engines • NetworkX Graph Theory • MedCPT Bi-Encoder • FAISS Vector Store • RAG
Keywords & Graphs (analysis_service.py): Keyword frequency % • NetworkX centralities (Degree, Closeness, Betweenness, Eigenvector, Clustering)
Country & Collaborations (country_service.py): Publication volume, coverage %, international papers, co-authorship collaboration network (nodes & links)
AI Neural Models & Vectors: MedCPT bi-encoder reranking (0-100 scores) • HDBSCAN semantic chunking + FAISS IndexFlatL2 • Gemini RAG query decomposition
↓ Computed Payloads
LAYER 7: VISUALIZATION & OUTPUT
Interactive UI Components • World Map • 2D/3D Force Networks • Word Cloud • RAG Citations • Export Pipelines
Geographic & Network Visualizers: TopoJSON World Map (react-simple-maps) • 2D Force Network (react-force-graph-2d) • 3D Spherical Space (Three.js WebGL)
Bibliometrics & Tables: Interactive SVG Word Cloud • Keyword Co-occurrence Network Graph SVG • Sortable Centrality & Country Ranking Tables
Conversational AI & Exports: RAG Markdown stream with [1], [2] citation pills • Collapsible source cards • CSV (UTF-8 BOM), JSON summary, PNG charts, PDF downloads
★ User Value
END-TO-END RESEARCH ROVER WORKFLOW: From Topic Inquiry to Bibliometric Insights, Verified Citations, and M.Tech Presentation Assets
